name: ZX_IMPORT_ERRORS
description: This table stores processing or validation errors. This would help the user to review the errors and take corrective action on imported transactions.

columns.name: IMPORT_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique Import Error Identifier

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Appliction Identifier

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the application event class for the transaction

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Primary transaction identifier

columns.name: SUMMARY_TAX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Summary tax line identifier

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Standard message name for the validation error

columns.name: INT_TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Column to temporarily store identifier of the interface line corresponding to this tax line

columns.name: INT_REC_NREC_TAX_DIST_ID
columns.description: Tax distribution record identfier

columns.name: INT_REC_NREC_TAX_DIST_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax distribution record number

columns.name: OTHER_DOC_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier for other documents like adjusted document if this error is specific to the other document

columns.name: OTHER_DOC_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code for other documents like adjusted document if this error is specific to the other document

columns.name: OTHER_DOC_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Event class code for other documents like adjusted document if this error is specific to the other document

columns.name: OTHER_DOC_TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier for other documents like adjusted document if this error is specific to the other document

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DIST_ID
columns.description: Item distribution identifier

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
